ports.title: Open ports
ports.protectedNote: Protected port — neither blocking nor stopping is possible from this screen.
ports.blockConfirmDescription: Closes access to this port from the outside via the firewall (ufw deny). The process keeps running — only its network reachability changes. Reversible.
ports.stopConfirmDescription: Sends a stop signal (SIGTERM) to the process listening on this port. Unlike "Block", the process itself stops — whatever it was serving becomes unavailable, not just unreachable from the outside. Irreversible action (it will need to be restarted manually).
ports.containerNote: Container — use Docker to stop it.
